childReport.manualNotes: The most significant finding is that 5 of the 9 tasks (book-quiz-2u3, book-quiz-9y1, book-quiz-13k, book-quiz-7hg, book-quiz-oqb) are already substantially implemented — collectively needing only ~2-3 days of polish. The real implementation work is in the data hydration pipeline (tasks jsh, gpr, se6) and the frontend profile page (task 568). The prior code review and security audit findings appear to have been addressed in the current codebase (passlib replaced with bcrypt directly, rate limiting added with slowapi, security headers added, hardcoded secrets removed). Two new ADRs (008: Data Hydration Source Strategy, 009: Question Generation Quality Assurance) are proposed to guide the remaining implementation. Recommended build order: Phase 1 (gpr → jsh → se6) first since the hydration pipeline unblocks everything else; Phase 2 (backend polish: 2u3, 13k, oqb) in parallel; Phase 3 (frontend: 7hg, 9y1, 568) last.
